value.rationale: A graph maximal degree is an independently motivated structural invariant for explicit heat timestep selection. The theorem gives a universally sharp first positivity horizon for all branching graphs, independent of triangles and topology, and demonstrates unavoidable stable-but-nonpositive steps; a four-vertex sharp reentrant star and limiting 1/sqrt(3) forbidden fraction make the phenomenon quantitative and interpretable.
